0|16e6653c8259ca5383126e1c6bcf7fe062af87fc|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"ixgbe: fix parsing of TC actions for HW offload
The previous code was optimistic
column2: accepting the offload of whole action

column1: chain when there was a single known action (drop/redirect). This results
in offloading a rule which should not be offloaded
cannot be reproduced in the hardware.
For example:
$ tc filter add dev eno1 parent ffff: protocol ip \
u32 ht 800: order 1 match tcp src 42 FFFF \
action mirred egress mirror dev enp1s16 pipe \
drop
The controller is unable to mirror the packet to a VF
offloads the rule by dropping the packet.
Change the approach of the function to a pessimistic one
chain when an unknown action is found. This is better suited for future
extensions.
Note that both recognized actions always return TC_ACT_SHOT
it is safe to ignore actions behind them.
